entities.name: First SS/PBCH Block Measurement Timing Configuration
entities.description: UE setup procedure for the first SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration using periodicityAndOffset parameter from smtc1 configuration.

entities.name: Additional SS/PBCH Block Measurement Timing Configuration
entities.description: UE setup procedure for additional SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration using periodicity parameter from smtc2 configuration and Offset/duration from smtc1.

entities.name: Additional SS/PBCH Block Measurement Timing Configuration for Cell Reselection
entities.description: UE setup procedure for additional SS/PBCH block measurement timing configuration using periodicity parameter from smtc2-LP configuration and Offset/duration from smtc configuration for that frequency.

entities.name: SS Block Measurement Timing Configuration List
entities.description: IAB-MT setup procedure for additional SS block measurement timing configuration using periodicityAndOffset parameter from each SSB-MTC3 configuration.

entities.name: RSSI Measurement Timing Configuration
entities.description: UE setup procedure for RSSI measurement timing configuration using rmtc-Periodicity and rmtc-SubframeOffset parameters.

entities.name: Periodicity and Offset Parameter
entities.description: Parameter providing periodicity and offset values for SMTC configuration.

entities.name: SMTC Occasion Condition
entities.description: Condition determining the first subframe of each SMTC occasion based on SFN mod T and subframe calculation.

entities.name: RMTC Occasion Condition
entities.description: Condition determining the first symbol of each RMTC occasion based on SFN mod T and subframe calculation.

entities.name: Measurement Restriction Property
entities.description: UE shall not consider SS/PBCH block transmission outside SMTC occasion for RRM measurements based on SS/PBCH blocks and CSI-RS.

entities.name: RSSI Measurement Restriction Property
entities.description: UE shall not consider RSSI measurements outside the configured RMTC occasion for RSSI and channel occupancy measurements.

relations.description: SMTC1 occasion timing is determined by the SMTC condition
SMTC2 configuration uses Offset parameter derived from periodicityAndOffset
SMTC2-LP configuration uses Offset parameter derived from periodicityAndOffset
RMTC occasion timing is determined by the RMTC condition
SMTC condition establishes measurement restriction property
RMTC condition establishes RSSI measurement restriction property
